h_join_01.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE u.gender = 'F'

h_join_02.sql: SELECT p.brand, COUNT(*) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 5

h_join_03.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE u.state = 'Texas'

h_join_04.sql: SELECT AVG(retail_price) FROM products WHERE category = 'Jeans'

h_join_05.sql: SELECT d.name, COUNT(*) FROM products p JOIN distribution_centers d ON d.id = p.distribution_center_id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1

h_date_01.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE created_at >= '2023-03-01' AND created_at < '2023-04-01'

h_date_02.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE created_at >= '2021-01-01' AND created_at < '2022-01-01'

h_date_03.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE shipped_at >= '2022-01-01' AND shipped_at < '2023-01-01'

h_date_04.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM created_at)::int FROM orders WHERE created_at >= '2022-01-01' AND created_at < '2023-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, 1 LIMIT 1

h_date_05.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE created_at >= '2023-06-15' AND created_at < '2023-06-16'

h_biz_01.sql: SELECT SUM(sale_price) FROM order_items WHERE status = 'Complete'

h_biz_02.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'Returned') / COUNT(*) FROM order_items

h_biz_03.sql: SELECT SUM(sale_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM order_items WHERE status = 'Complete'

h_biz_04.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FROM events WHERE event_type = 'purchase'

h_biz_05.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(oi.sale_price - p.cost) / SUM(oi.sale_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.status = 'Complete'

h_empty_01.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'Teleported'

h_empty_02.sql: SELECT id FROM products WHERE brand = 'Zzyzx Fashion'

h_empty_03.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE created_at < '2000-01-01'

h_empty_04.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE age > 120

h_empty_05.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE event_type = 'teleport'

h_agg_01.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT user_id FROM orders GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 3) t

h_agg_03.sql: SELECT state, COUNT(*) FROM users GROUP BY state ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 3

h_agg_05.sql: SELECT department, COUNT(*) FROM products GROUP BY department ORDER BY 1

h_agg_06.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users u WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.id)

h_agg_07.sql: SELECT traffic_source, AVG(age) FROM users GROUP BY traffic_source ORDER BY 1

h_agg_08.sql: SELECT p.category, AVG(oi.sale_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1

h_agg_09.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'Cancelled' AND created_at >= '2023-01-01' AND created_at < '2024-01-01'

h_agg_10.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE traffic_source = 'Search') / COUNT(*) FROM users
